# OKF Conformance Checking for Wiki Bundles

This module provides a checker that verifies a wiki bundle emitted by the compiler against OKF conformance rules. It checks that every markdown file meets the prescribed frontmatter structure and constraints, surfacing explicit issues for human or automated review. This ensures that emitted bundles do not drift from structural conventions and remain spec-compliant.
